comparison.objective: Load an IV set into a pump module without lifting, stretching, or twisting it; candidate screens rigid finishing media.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered fitment and clamp insertion with flexible-tube management versus bimanual rigid-body granular-flow control.
comparison.success_condition: Fitment seated first, clamp home, tubing unstretched/untwisted, hands clear for 2 s versus ≥98% media recovery, washers retained, screen released for 3 s.
comparison.reason: Flexible medical-set installation is unrelated to selective screening.
